apps.name: YouTubePlus
apps.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP
apps.localizedDescription: YouTubePlus (formerly YTLite) is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube developed by Dayanch96. It provides complete ad blocking, background playback, offline video and audio downloads, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), SponsorBlock integration, gesture controls, and customizable interface settings.
apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.24.3 | YouTubePlus_21.24.3_5.2.2

### Latest Stable Release, ENJOY!!
##### Cracked by [zarzelworkshop](https://t.me/zarzelworkshop)

> [!NOTE]
> - :key: no subscription required
> - ✅ Working Download Manager, switch to overlay button before downloading.
> - 🎥 Bundled with **YTUHD**. it is broken in +21.25.5 versions as of now. max resolution is 1080p60. devices with native AV1 can still see 4K.
> - 🔧 Updated Gonerino and YT Headers
> - Enable "**Both** Download button placement" under Downloading setting
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTUHD` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`  `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!WARNING]
> - Versions **+21.25.5 and newer** are **not recommended** right now.  
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled with main tweak are currently unstable on newer versions.

compatibility.notes: Official project: dayanch96/YTLite ('YouTube Plus'). The upstream repo publishes the tweak as a .deb only; this source serves a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak by mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
